aboutText: JLV Electric has been providing licensed, insured electrical services to homes and businesses across Tullamarine and Melbourne's north for years. Our experienced team delivers quality work with clear communication, ensuring every job is done right the first time. From residential repairs and fault finding to commercial fit-outs and ongoing maintenance, we take pride in tidy finishes and strict adherence to Australian safety standards.
servicesText: Whether it is a residential repair, commercial fit-out or new build, our Tullamarine-based electricians deliver reliable solutions with upfront advice and clear communication at every step.

services.title: Residential Electrical
services.desc: Complete home electrical services including repairs, rewiring and safety checks for Tullamarine families and homeowners.

services.title: Commercial Fit-Outs
services.desc: Electrical fit-outs for shops, offices and commercial spaces across Melbourne's north, completed to Australian standards.

services.title: Switchboard Upgrades
services.desc: Upgrade your outdated switchboard for improved safety and compliance with current Australian electrical regulations.

services.title: Fault Finding & Repairs
services.desc: Fast, accurate diagnosis and repair of electrical faults to keep your home or business safe and running smoothly.

services.title: Lighting Installation
services.desc: Interior and exterior lighting solutions including LED upgrades, downlights and energy-efficient installations.

services.title: Ongoing Maintenance
services.desc: Scheduled electrical maintenance for properties and businesses, preventing issues before they become costly problems.
